> EcoChain Fire Sentinel is a low-cost IoT sensor node for early forest-fire risk detection. It uses an ESP32-C3 and environmental sensors to continuously monitor temperature, humidity, smoke/air-quality indicators, and vegetation dryness. The node will analyze sensor data locally and send measurements and alerts to a central GIALAI EcoChain dashboard for real-time visualization and risk analysis. The goal is to build an affordable prototype that can complement satellite fire data and help identify areas that need early verification. I will test the system under different environmental conditions and measure detection accuracy, response time, and false alarms.
